name: TrackerXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: A tracker sequencer and sampler for Force and MPC, ported from the open-source Polyend tracker firmware: 16-track pattern editor, song, sample editor, with the 19 LXRXXL ZYNTH voices, BAZZLINE bass sounds and LXRXXL drums as its synths. Data wheel and Q-Links. Not tested on a device yet.
